title: Process activity event (ingest)
summary: Endpoint process-execution telemetry bound to OCSF System Activity / Process Activity (class 1007). Carries the shadow-copy-deletion, ransomware-extension-rename, and overpass-the-hash signals consumed by the ransomware_containment playbook's triage step. Read by the SOC's EDR/XDR pipe; the playbook never reaches into the operator's endpoint plane directly.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 — System Activity category (1), Process Activity class (1007)
